wholeCurrentHeldGoal.title: Säure-Base-Paare vergleichen
wholeCurrentHeldGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann mithilfe des Brønsted-Modells Reaktionsrichtungen abschätzen, Oxonium- und Hydroxidionen nachweisen und Modellvorstellungen reflektieren.
wholeCurrentHeldGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can estimate reaction directions using the Brønsted model, detect oxonium and hydroxide ions, and reflect on model concepts.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Säure-Base-Paare vergleichen
resourceLinks.altText: Didaktische Visualisierung zum Lernziel "Säure-Base-Paare vergleichen". Die lernende Person kann mithilfe des Brønsted-Modells Reaktionsrichtungen abschätzen, Oxonium- und Hydroxidionen nachweisen und Modellvorstellungen reflektieren.

instructions: Check six candidate role removals against full original page/whole source goal and retained strict1c case profile; source identity, all original clauses and regional stage/course must remain preserved. Do not re-review the valid three goals.

Check BB/BE whole contextual Nachweisreaktionen against both new supplied indicator/proton source cases and retained d2/fd/1c scopes. Decide the exact source-role union without inferring all organic-family obligations or a unique ion species from color.
Check HB Q original MWG plus acid AND base strength on particle level against both new quantitative/structure cases; distinguish derived extraction wording, current composition Q, K and kinetics.

The current B477 atomicity issue is not resolved by source-role correction. Decide a scope-preserving reuse/split of all three original performances only after exact source/stage/reuse agreement; no new stable ID, cluster change or narrower original goal is adopted here.

The actual historical generic normative model-reflection clause can support an authored acid/base application, but it is not a literal universal acid/base content requirement. Held277 is not strict simply because it appears as a reusable name.
If whole481 is later used as a source witness, its complete current D/P/A/M/V and other actually affected duties remain required. These cases are a bounded input, not approval of that entire goal.

templates.titleEn: Explain the direction of proton transfers
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die bevorzugte Richtung einer Protonenübertragung im betrachteten Medium mit korrespondierenden Säure-Base-Paaren und gegebenen relativen Säure- und Basenstärken begründen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can justify the preferred direction of a proton transfer in the considered medium using conjugate acid-base pairs and supplied relative acid and base strengths.

templates.titleEn: Provide qualitative evidence for hydronium and hydroxide ions
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann aus geeigneten Indikatorbefunden den sauren oder basischen Charakter einer wässrigen Probe begründen und diesen im Teilchenmodell auf einen Überschuss von Oxonium- oder Hydroxidionen beziehen.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can justify the acidic or basic character of an aqueous sample from suitable indicator observations and relate it in the particle model to an excess of hydronium or hydroxide ions.

templates.titleEn: Reflect on the scope of acid-base models
templates.descriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann die Aussagen des Arrhenius- und des Brønsted-Konzepts an geeigneten Säure-Base-Beispielen vergleichen und begründen, welche Teilchen- und Lösungsaussagen das jeweilige Modell erlaubt.
templates.descriptionEn: The learner can compare the Arrhenius and Brønsted concepts using suitable acid-base examples and justify which statements about species and solutions each model supports.

oldHeldProposalKeptAsLineage.reuseLimits: d2 carries indicator evidence but not automatically relative-ion particle inference. fd309 currently says presence of H3O+/OH−; both species occur in aqueous solutions, so exact reuse needs bounded excess/relative-concentration wording review outside this packet before adoption. 481 is the distinct quantitative pK/MWG target, not a substitute for all generic reflection.
oldHeldProposalKeptAsLineage.sourceStageHold: HE G9 10.3 pair/ampholyte clauses do not license a new whole direction target there. HB original Q S23 licenses strengths and equilibrium jointly with other goals; extraction pK wording is derived. General model reflection has no separately established exact primary operator here. No new ID until source/stage and reuse review settle all three original performances.
